why: The same turn tree as turn_srp_river_betting, with a higher iteration cap, to measure cold time until NashConv/pot is at most 0.001. It does not replace the 400-iteration reference.
study_inputs_note: Ranges are study inputs for this benchmark. They are not a solved preflop equilibrium. The queen-high turn is two-tone (Qc 2c), so some rivers complete a club flush and change the betting.
memory_note: 2048 is the engine allocation budget (--memory-mib), not an operating-system limit and not process RSS. The street default is 1024 MiB. The street-config document also records that budget.
eval_interval_source: --accuracy 0.001 hardcodes eval_interval to 20. There is no flag to change that cadence.
betting_note: Identical betting to turn_srp_river_betting. Shares benchmarks/study/configs/turn_srp_river_betting.txt. All-in is offered. max-raises is 2.
